title.narrative: Support to the Regional School of Public Administration (ReSPA).

description.narrative: ReSPAs purpose is to help governments in the region develop better public administration, public services and overall governance systems for their citizens and businesses, and prepare them for membership in the European Union (EU) through the organisation of trainings, networking activities, conferences, elaboration of studies, peer-to-peer learning and other mechanisms.
